notes: The speed setup with --transport shm (tests/perf/speed/speed.py): each stack's self pair over its shared-memory route, measured on the Linux test host in one exclusive board window on 2026-11-13; ZeroDDS three runs, the vendors two.
A cell's udp_out_datagrams (the UDP datagrams the host sent while it ran) says which way the samples went: 0 to 128 per cell for these four rows, with up to three million samples written.

Cyclone DDS 11.0.1 through its PSMX plugin for iceoryx (libpsmx_iox, iox-roudi running); Fast DDS 3.6.1 with its shared-memory transport and data sharing at its default; RTI Connext 7.7.0 with the shmem builtin transport; ZeroDDS with transport.same_host_shm.

Not in this file: OpenDDS 3.34.0 (its shmem configuration delivered 0.13 % of the samples), HDDS 1.1.5 (sent every sample as a UDP datagram with shm_require), OpenSplice 6.9 (single-process configurations only), Dust DDS 0.16.0 (no shared-memory transport); OPEN-ITEMS 52.
